Hi Sophie / Marissa —

Thanks for the detailed questions — below are our standard positions and options; happy to jump on a short call if you want to walk through specifics.

SOC 2 / BAA
- SOC 2: Redwood has completed SOC 2 Type I and is currently undergoing Type II assessment; we expect Type II attestation in Q3 2026. In the meantime we can provide our SOC 2 Type I report and evidence of the controls in scope (policy docs, internal control matrix, and select audit artifacts) under NDA.
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood is able to sign a BAA. For customers handling PHI we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments to meet isolation preferences; however, we can support BAAs for Hosted customers with contractual and technical controls in place. Please send your BAA template (or we can provide ours).

Data deletion SLAs (summary)
- Primary customer data (production customer objects stored in customer-controlled projects): Upon a validated deletion request Redwood initiates logical deletion and access revocation immediately and completes logical deletion within 30 days.
- Backups / snapshots (disaster recovery): Default retention is 90 days. Backups are encrypted (KMS) and retained to meet DR requirements; however, we can offer shorter backup retention (e.g., 30 days) for enterprise contracts at negotiation.
- Physical deletion of backup media: because of storage-level retention and cross-region replication, full physical purging may take up to 90 days after logical deletion is completed. We track and can provide proof of deletion operations (timestamps) as part of compliance requests.

Log retention (details)
- Application/diagnostic logs: default 90 days; can be configured per-customer for shorter/longer windows depending on plan and regulatory needs.
- Audit/security logs (authentication, admin actions, configuration changes): default 365 days for enterprise customers; can export or extend retention on request for compliance/forensics.

Operational notes
- All data at rest and in transit is encrypted; backups use KMS-managed keys. Customer-managed keys (BYOK) are available on Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Deletion requests are tracked through our ticketing system; we provide timestamps and an execution report on completion.
- For expedited purges (e.g., legal or regulatory requirement to shorten backup retention immediately) we can coordinate an accelerated schedule but may need to move workloads to a dedicated OU and schedule a controlled purge window.

Attachments / evidence
- I've attached a high-level SOC coverage summary (SOC2-coverage-summary.pdf) and can provide more artifacts under NDA.

Let me know if that addresses Amaya's requirements or if you'd like a quick call (30m) to walk through the questionnaire responses live.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
